decisions.reason: The basket-weave scale and mustard-edge changes do not alter the zebra print. The zebra border instruction is a separate same-message decision already represented in its history.

The basket-weave scale and edge treatment do not change the project-wide color-management state. The Pantone and ICC workflow is a separate same-message decision already represented in this Requirement.
A fine mustard outline on the basket weave does not change the mustard block-color pareo's interior or border colors.
The basket-weave scale and mustard outline do not alter the terracotta block-color pareo's interior or border colors.
The basket-weave visual specifications do not change the requirement to deliver final production-ready artwork files.
